notes: Synthetic incidents for the scenario harness (spec 10.1). team_script lists what the incident team returns on each call: a plan, a reason it couldn't make one, or an error it raises. decisions are what the facility manager does after each plan. Buildings, assets and manuals are invented.

boiler_grounded.summary: Boiler HX-200 in plant room B shows E04 (low water pressure). Repressurise, check the expansion vessel, dispatch an HVAC technician today.

claims.statement: E04 on the HX-200 means system pressure below 0.8 bar.
The same boiler had a pressure fault 12 days ago.
Isolate the boiler's electrical supply before opening the casing.

actions.description: HVAC technician to plant room B today
Expansion vessel 24 L (if the pre-charge test fails)
Tell residents heating is being restored this afternoon

boiler_after_feedback.summary: Revised: test the expansion vessel pre-charge before ordering parts; dispatch today.

claims.statement: A failed expansion vessel causes repeated pressure loss.

electrical_blocked.summary: Burning smell at distribution board DB-3. Replace the board.

claims.statement: Work on DB-3 requires an isolation permit and a qualified electrician.

electrical_blocked.safety_notes: No isolation permit is on record for DB-3.

electrical_permitted.summary: Isolate DB-3 under permit P-77, then inspect before any replacement.

claims.statement: Permit P-77 covers isolation of DB-3.

actions.description: Lock out DB-3 under permit P-77

chiller_expensive.summary: Chiller compressor failure on the roof plant. Replace the compressor.

claims.statement: Compressor current draw is outside the manufacturer's range.
The vendor's SLA guarantees a replacement within 48 hours.

leak_unverified.summary: Water ingress above unit 8F. Likely a failed riser joint.

claims.statement: The riser joint above 8F was replaced last year.
Isolate the riser at valve V-8 before work.

scenarios.description: A grounded plan is approved; nothing happens before approval
The manager asks for a revision; the team gets the feedback and its previous plan

decisions.feedback: Test the expansion vessel before ordering parts.

expect.feedback_seen: Test the expansion vessel before ordering parts.

scenarios.description: The manager rejects the plan; the team is not called again
A plan with a safety block can't be approved; a revised, permitted plan can

decisions.feedback: Find the isolation permit or raise one first.

scenarios.description: A plan above the cost threshold needs an explicit cost confirmation
A claim without a citation is flagged as unverified
The team keeps failing: retried, dead-lettered, and handed to a person
The team stops at its budget without a plan: a person decides
An emergency can never be sent to the incident team
